posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
There isn't a plugin that transforms the entire engine to work like one of those games. You need to understand RPG Maker events, especially variables to create different situations.
Menus and view-type (Isometric 2d?) would require plugins to automate this, which could be done through events but wouldn't be worthwhile.

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body: This engine is really meant for RPGs, and not other types of games. If you know a lot of JS coding you might be able to pull it off, or know the events inside and out and a lot of messing around maybe. But even then it will probably way more jank than it is worth.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
There is no specific guide for such type of games.
you start with the build-in tutorial and learn how to map and how to use events.
depending on your experience in logic and programming you might want to follow some advanced guides on events - for example the old but still viable "variables Guide" game from Celianna (I linked it in my starting point tutorial.
only after you have a good handle on events and variables, you start making a list of what options you want in your game, and then create those events one at a time with your knowledge.
There is absolutely no way a guide can do this for you, because you need to understand what the commands do and why they are used instead of simply copying something without understanding it.
And that is because such a game needs complex connecting logic that you have to enter into the events yourself, that cannot be created for you.

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
So I'm just basing this on your post count, that you're new to the engine?
If so, I highly recommend getting used to the game engine first, including how switches, variables, conditional branches, plugins, and scripts work.
You need a solid foundation and understanding of how the engine works before you start doing something it wasn't designed for.
Can it do it? Yes, will it be complicated and require expert knowledge? 188% yes.
As for the guide part, even if there was a guide, it would be very extensive and huge to do.
What type of tycoon game did you have in mind?
